title: EVALUATING COUNTERFACTUAL EXPLANATIONS USING PEARL'S COUNTERFACTUAL METHOD
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical validation of counterfactual explanations based on causal correctness and model biases. While counterfactuals have ethical implications in application (e.g., advising patients, bank loans), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith aspects as a core component of its research. Mentions of 'feasibility/plausibility' and 'actionable' are discussed within the technical context of causal relationships and realistic feature changes, not broader ethical evaluations.
